name: IPVanish
description: IPVanish is a long-running consumer VPN service (Ziff Davis) selling monthly, quarterly and annual plans with apps for all major platforms. Its CJ Affiliate program pays a flat 50% commission on every plan, a rate structure that suits VPN review and privacy content.

evidence.summary: IPVanish runs a CJ Affiliate program paying a flat 50% commission on all plans (monthly, quarterly and annual), with a 45-day cookie and commissions approved on day 31. The listing mentions no cap on payouts, but that is a third-party listing claim only, so the cap is recorded as unknown.

Corroborating listings (LinkWhisper, PropellerAds) report the same CJ program at 50%. A separate direct program run on TUNE is reported elsewhere at up to 100% on first sales plus 35% recurring; the CJ program is the one recorded here.

opportunity.title: IPVanish Affiliate Program — flat 50% on all plans via CJ Affiliate

reasons.niche_fit: VPNs are a core creator niche across YouTube, TikTok and blogs; privacy and streaming content converts well.
reasons.ugc_evidence: VPN reviews, speed tests and setup tutorials are proven UGC formats for this category.
reasons.compensation: Flat 50% on every plan through CJ is a strong, simple rate; no earnings cap is stated on any fetched source, so the cap is honestly unknown.
reasons.contact_access: No direct affiliate email was verified on a fetched page; contact runs through CJ Affiliate.
reasons.opportunity_availability: The CJ program is open to apply; approval runs through the network.
reasons.credibility: Established VPN brand owned by Ziff Davis with consistent terms reported across multiple program listings.

name: CyberGhost
description: CyberGhost is a major consumer VPN founded in 2011 in Bucharest, Romania, reporting 38 million users. Its own affiliate page advertises commissions of up to 100% and routes signups through its HasOffers (TUNE) portal.

evidence.summary: CyberGhost's own affiliate page states 'up to 100% in commissions' and routes signup through its HasOffers portal at affiliates.kape.com; the page publishes the affiliate contact Updates@cyberghost.ro. The page states no earnings cap.

Third-party program listings conflict on the effective rate range (30-100% and 40-100% both reported), so commission_rate is recorded as null rather than guessed; the brand's own 'up to 100%' is a rate ceiling, not a standard rate.

opportunity.title: CyberGhost Affiliate Program — up to 100% headline rate via HasOffers (TUNE)

reasons.niche_fit: One of the largest consumer VPN brands, a staple of tech and privacy creator content.
reasons.ugc_evidence: VPN comparison and tutorial content is a proven format; the brand is heavily promoted by creators already.
reasons.compensation: The headline 'up to 100%' is attractive but the effective rate is not published consistently across sources, so compensation is scored cautiously and the rate is null.
reasons.contact_access: A direct affiliate email (Updates@cyberghost.ro) is published on the brand's own affiliate page.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open signup through the brand's HasOffers portal.
reasons.credibility: Operating since 2011 with a reported 38 million users.

name: hide.me
description: hide.me is a consumer VPN operated by eVenture Ltd (Malaysia). Its own affiliate page offers flexible commissions from 30% with lifetime revenue share, signup through its Post Affiliate Pro portal, and a dedicated affiliate manager.

opportunity.title: hide.me Affiliate Program — 30% lifetime revenue share via Post Affiliate Pro

name: Keeper Security
description: Keeper Security makes the Keeper password manager and cybersecurity platform for consumers and businesses. Its affiliate program pays a minimum of 10% on all sales, with consumer affiliates joining via Rakuten Advertising and a PartnerStack track paying 10% for a customer's first year plus $60 per qualified business lead.

evidence.summary: Keeper's own PartnerStack marketplace listing states: 'Earn 10% for every order you bring in for the first year of the customer and earn $60 for every qualified lead.' No earnings cap is stated.

Program research read from Keeper's own partnerships page reports a minimum 10% commission on all sales with performance tiers and bonuses; consumer affiliates join via Rakuten Advertising and business affiliates via PartnerStack. Keeper's own page does not publish cookie or payout terms.

opportunity.title: Keeper Security Affiliate Program — 10% first-year via PartnerStack (consumer track on Rakuten)

reasons.niche_fit: Password managers fit tech, productivity and security-awareness creator niches.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Setup walkthroughs and 'stop reusing passwords' content are proven formats for this product type.
reasons.compensation: 10% is modest next to VPN rates, but PartnerStack adds a $60 qualified-lead bounty and Keeper publishes performance tiers and bonuses.
reasons.contact_access: No direct affiliate email was verified on a fetched page; joining runs through PartnerStack or Rakuten.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application on PartnerStack; a separate consumer track runs on Rakuten Advertising.
reasons.credibility: Established cybersecurity company with a published partnerships program.

evidence.summary: Lasso's program listing reports Nolah paying $105 to $200 per sale with a 180-day cookie. No earnings cap is stated.

reasons.credibility: Established DTC mattress brand with a long-running affiliate presence.

reasons.contact_access: No direct affiliate email was verified on a fetched page; applications are reviewed manually through the program page.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application with manual review via GoAffPro.
